title: Backend dirtyKeys processing and sync result response (F-001 backend)
description: Extend FeaturesMessageHandler to accept optional dirtyKeys from the save message. When dirtyKeys is provided, pass it to SettingsSyncService.syncFeaturesToSettingsJson for targeted sync. Enhance the save response to include a syncResult object (synced count, failed keys, skipped count). When dirtyKeys is absent, fall back to current full-sync behavior for backward compatibility.

Save response includes syncResult: { synced: number, failed: string[], skipped: number }
